description: .NET Project templates, composed to give you advantage akin to a "stacked card deck".
releaseNotes:
✨ Features
- Rework API versioning with per-version OpenAPI documents wired into Scalar (2ac715a)
- Simplify versioning setup and bump FastEndpoints to beta.21 (3784382)
- Exclude InheritableApiVersionAttribute from MinimalAPI & FastEndpoints templates (1b11486)

🚀 Improvements
- Migrate build system from NUKE to FALLOUT (d170ae7)
- Migrate from VSTest to Microsoft Test Platform V2 (24c2048)

🔧 Chores
- Bump Scalar.AspNetCore to 2.16.16 (f4af94c)
- Bump Roslynator.Analyzers to 4.16.1 (8c80ff6)
- Bump FastEndpoints and ICU package versions (75933f9, 54bd4d9)
- Bump Azure App Configuration OCI image version (8c7a2bd)
- Bump 3rd party NuGet dependencies (b35e193, a22c2fe, bfd7876, bc35b49)
title: Stacked Deck Project Templates
